basic_info.description: Welcome to this stunning corner 3BD/2BA condo with an office, panoramic bay views, and a south-facing balcony: Candlestick Point Residence 3209. This move-in-ready home has been recently upgraded with luxury vinyl plank waterproof flooring throughout and brand-new carpets in the bedrooms. Enjoy the serene water views from your private balcony every day and night. The condo offers easy access to both the Peninsula and the city of San Francisco, right off the highway, and is located in a secure building with 24/7 gated security. The building provides plenty of free guest parking, and this unit comes with one assigned parking space.    The Candlestick Point complex offers gym facilities, guest parking, and a 24-hour guard. The building features a central courtyard and open green space, along with a convenient and free shuttle bus service to Caltrain, BART, and Muni bus stops. It is also in close proximity to walking trails, the 20-acre wildlife refuge of Bayview Park, and the Candlestick Point State Recreation Area. The serenity away from the hustle and bustle of the city is just one of the reasons Candlestick Point residents are delighted to live in the area.
